outcome: Fetal outcomes (e.g., preterm birth, low birth weight, stillbirth)
cohort: 100 pregnant women with placenta previa admitted to the Department of Obstetrics and Gynaecology, GGH, Kakinada, between October 2020 and October 2022.
finding: The study aimed to evaluate the prevalence of placenta previa and associated maternal and fetal risks, highlighting the importance of early identification and management.
mod_finding: 66% of the participants with placenta previa underwent elective caesarean section.
gest_age: Half of the study subjects were at term pregnancy.
birth_weight: 61% of the babies born to mothers with placenta previa had low birth weight.
